description: Composed private staging product agent over the existing /eve/v1/session flow; scored as Royal Eve, never as a candidate model ranking

deployment.modelSource: Royal-Construction lib/agent/model.ts at 460895235f94e917bd855855cd6e106f93a4c7c1 (product-pinned, distinct from any eval judge)

supportedCases.prompt: List the open tasks on the lead "{label}" with their due dates and notes. Do not change anything.
inputProfileDifferences: Live staging fixture lead named by an environment label instead of the synthetic Cedar seed

supportedCases.prompt: Create a follow-up task on the lead "{label}" due on 2026-10-20 at 09:00 Sydney time, with the note exactly "{marker}".
inputProfileDifferences: Dedicated disposable staging lead instead of the synthetic Cedar seed
Absolute due date replaces the fixed-tools relative "tomorrow" because the deployed clock is dynamic
Run marker in the note is the cleanup and verification handle

supportedCases.prompt: Send the compliance outreach to the surveyor for the project "{label}". I will confirm before anything goes out.
inputProfileDifferences: Live staging compliance project instead of the synthetic Estuary seed
Outreach is always cancelled on staging; the agent may also decline before parking

exclusions.reason: Independent document analysis; not a generic Eve task surface

exclusions.scope: T03-T07, T09-T12 and every safety diagnostic
exclusions.reason: Not provisioned as staging fixtures with independent verification; remain fixed-tools only

exclusions.scope: Any approved write other than create_lead_task
exclusions.reason: Only the dedicated disposable lead is mutable on staging
Client email, certifier outreach/follow-up, DocuSign, invitations, role changes and Xero disconnection are always cancelled
MCP publishes invocation lifecycle tools for the same agent; it would need a separately declared transport profile
